messages:
jane_sales: Hey team — LumaHealth legal wants a minimal evidence bundle for their POC approval. They asked for SOC2 excerpts, ISO residency statement, and a signed pen-test letter. Also asking whether staging can be in Dedicated or needs Private. Any quick guidance?

mike_solutions: Quick answers: we can do Hosted for POC unless they require on-prem or EU-only residency. Dedicated or Private if they need tenancy/isolation or KMS separation.

sam_se: For the POC itself we usually offer a short-lived Dedicated pool (reserved for the trial) — gives predictable perf and isolates data. No infra change for a week-long POC.

lucy_security: For compliance artifacts we can provide: SOC2 attestation (summary + scoped controls), ISO residency statement, encryption details, and our pen-test letter template. Pen-test letter needs vendor name + target scope filled in; we sign that.

jane_sales: Perfect. LumaHealth asked specifically: can we provide a signed pen-test letter that states we will permit a customer-run scan on the POC staging endpoints (not prod)?

lucy_security: Yes, we can. Standard caveats: limited to test IPs, no social-engineering, and we ask for 48h notice. We'll include that in the template.

claudia_compliance: I can assemble a one-page "POC assurance pack" with the above items + a short checklist for their auditors. ETA 3 business days if you provide the customer legal name and contact.

jane_sales: Sending now — customer legal name is Luma Health Inc. Contact: legal@lumahealth.example.

mike_solutions: Also FYI — if they request EU data residency during the POC we need to spin the instance in eu-west and enable EU KMS. That adds ~2 business days and a small infra fee; will clarify pricing.

jane_sales: Good to flag pricing. Can you share a quick line I can give procurement about cost delta?

mike_solutions: Short version: Dedicated EU staging adds a one-time setup fee (~$Xk) + a daily reserved rate for the GPU pool. I'll get numbers, ~24h.

devops-bot: Upload endpoint for evidence: sftp to secure-bucket.redwood-internal.svc

``` 
sftp luma-evidence@secure-bucket.redwood-internal.svc
put luma_evidence_zip.zip
``` 

lucy_security: I'll attach the pen-test letter template and the SOC2 excerpt to the pack. We require customer confirmation of scanning windows before we sign.

claudia_compliance: One more note — if they want encrypted logs to be excluded from the pack, we can provide redacted logs. Confirm what they need.

jane_sales: I'll ask them about redaction and scanning windows. Thanks everyone — will update in this thread after legal replies. :thumbsup:
